purpose: Bound one PMXT parquet sample token to official Polymarket CLOB and Gamma market metadata before accepting any NT BinaryOption mapping.

official_docs.use: Documents CLOB market metadata through GET /clob-markets/{condition_id}, including tokens, minimum order size, minimum tick size, and accepting-order timestamp.

extracted_fields.question: Will Zelenskyy and Putin meet next in Saudi Arabia before 2027?

source_backed_nt_binary_option_field_sta.evidence: Sample token id is source-backed; final InstrumentId formatting must be generic and derive venue from the source binding, not from hardcoded venue code.
PMXT asset_id and official token_id match the sampled token.
Registry source binding declares product_family=prediction_market_outcome and market_structure_fixture=binary-option.
The bounded official probes do not prove the exact NT settlement/collateral currency field.
CLOB aot and Gamma acceptingOrdersTimestamp both give 2025-11-06T15:54:33Z; Gamma startDate differs and needs a documented mapping rule.
Gamma endDate gives 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z; expiration versus final settlement semantics still need a documented mapping rule.
minimum_tick_size/orderPriceMinTickSize is 0.001, implying precision 3 for this sample.
PMXT source schema reports size DECIMAL(18,6), but official order-size precision/increment has not been proven for NT instrument construction.
CLOB minimum_tick_size and Gamma orderPriceMinTickSize are both 0.001.
CLOB/Gamma minimum order size is 5, but that is not the same proof as order-size increment.
CLOB mos and Gamma orderMinSize are both 5; mapping to NT optional min_quantity still needs converter/readback proof.
CLOB token metadata maps the sampled token to Yes and the twin token to No; Gamma outcomes and clobTokenIds agree.
Gamma feesEnabled=false and CLOB fee fields are absent/null, but NT maker_fee semantics require an explicit mapping rule before acceptance.
Gamma feesEnabled=false and CLOB fee fields are absent/null, but NT taker_fee semantics require an explicit mapping rule before acceptance.

mapping_conclusion.reason: The bounded official join removes the earlier missing-token-metadata blocker for outcome label, price increment, minimum order size, and candidate activation/expiration timestamps. It does not yet prove every checked NT BinaryOption field or a committed generic converter plus ParquetDataCatalog read-back.
required_next_evidence: generic token-id to InstrumentId/raw_symbol rule deriving venue from TOML source binding metadata
source-backed settlement/collateral currency mapping for NT BinaryOption currency
documented activation_ns rule choosing accepting-order timestamp versus market startDate
documented expiration_ns rule for endDate versus settlement/finalization semantics
explicit maker_fee/taker_fee mapping rule when Gamma feesEnabled=false and CLOB fee fields are absent
committed generic PMXT order-book adapter that writes NT BinaryOption, OrderBookDelta, and TradeTick without venue constants
ParquetDataCatalog write plus query_typed_data read-back for the selected sample under artifact-root staging
